title: Review Packet
user: A professional handing an internally reviewed document to an external reviewer who needs comments, change context, and attachments visible without giving access to the source workspace.
smallest_useful_product: Static local packet builder: add a PDF, structured comments/decisions, source links, and attachments; export a self-contained HTML folder and print stylesheet.
success_measure: In a usability test, 8 of 10 external reviewers can locate every requested comment, decision, and attachment without signing in or asking the sender for context.
constraints: Do not embed third-party document content without user authority; warn about sensitive data in exported folders; no claims of legal record retention.
